label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: The two-panel green board, blue lower wall, pale upper wall, hanging notice, and three desk/chair arrangements clearly identify the reference classroom.
The notice remains above the board, with the rear desk left of center and foreground desks on the left and right. The principal wall and furniture relationships are preserved.
Board aspect ratio, notice size, and projected desk widths closely correspond to the target. Furniture proportions are simplified but remain recognizable.
Green board, blue paint, cream wall, pale wooden furniture, and gray supports retain distinct surface identities. Colors are lighter and wear is less convincing than the target.
Bright, soft illumination leaves all principal content legible. Reduced contrast and visible sampling noise weaken the atmosphere without obscuring the scene.
Complementary views reveal tabletop depth, separate legs, chair seats, and furniture spacing in front of the wall, establishing genuine three-dimensional construction.
Actual wall, board, notice, desk and chair components are finite nonempty meshes with material slots and addressable parent chains. Their materials contain connected surface shaders.

dimension_scores.evidence: Strong correspondence in composition and major content, but the distinctive erased chalk swirls, aged surfaces, and furniture contours are substantially simplified.
Desks have plausible leg arrangements, but chairs have only two short back-support rods and no complete ground-reaching support structure, making the seats physically unconvincing.
The principal palette matches, but washed-out wood and blue paint, rectangular chair backs, and uniform vertical board streaks lose much of the reference character.
Visible render noise, sharp primitive furniture shapes, sparse construction details, and minimal aging produce a rough model appearance.
Principal horizontal and vertical placements closely match, and alternate views establish consistent foreground and rear furniture spacing.
Major projected proportions fit the target well, though the rear chair's large seat-to-back separation and tall desk-to-seat relationship are less convincing in depth.
Soft lighting provides clear visibility and coherent shadows, but weak tonal contrast, generic furniture surfaces, and noisy shading reduce material credibility.
All major reference-visible object categories and furniture counts are represented. Chair support construction and characteristic wear details remain incomplete.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
